assets.description: M1 player character. Segmented, unrigged: named nodes eye/head/torso/arm.l/arm.r/leg.l/leg.r; limb pivots at shoulder and hip; eye at 1.7 m, -Z forward; head is a sibling of eye so the local player can hide it without hiding the camera. Orange suit with teal backpack, reads from 50 m and from the inside-down view.
Rounded boulder variant, fine facets. Unit-sized, base at origin, up +Y; client seats on surface, orients radially, scales 0.3-1.5 m.
Sharp angular shard variant, coarse facets, high-amplitude noise.

Hero scout ship for M2 (built early so M2 does not wait on art). -Z forward, origin at ground level. Carries the seat contract: seat.pilot plus seat.passenger.0/1 empty nodes at the eye point. Walk-in cockpit with open canopy, glass (alphaMode BLEND), floor, dash, lit console panel and seats; hull is double-sided so the interior renders from the pilot seat.

Phase 2 pulse rifle. -Z forward. Named empty nodes: `grip` (where the character's right hand holds it, at the origin of the hand pose) and `muzzle` (barrel tip, -Z, where the flash and tracer originate). Reads in silhouette from 30 m and from the first-person down-view at 0.5 m.

Phase 2 quartermaster NPC. Same segmented node layout as char.player (eye/head/torso/arm.l/arm.r/leg.l/leg.r) so the client's procedural animation and nametag code work unchanged; different palette so it does not read as a player.
Phase 2 target dummy. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z. Concentric plate on a post, ~1.8 m tall. Node `plate` is coloured by the client to show hit/reset state.
Phase 2 range wall segment. Unit box, base at origin, up +Y, scaled by the client to the collider's half-extents. Visual only — the authoritative shape is the `colliders` message.
Phase 2 cover post. Unit sphere, centre at origin, scaled to the sphere collider's radius. Visual only, as above.
